jd:
Junior Data Analyst - Fernhollow Foods

About the role
Fernhollow is a regional grocery chain building an analytics team. This is an entry-level role for a curious analyst. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Answer business questions with data
- Build charts and dashboards for store teams
- Run and evaluate small experiments

Requirements
- SQL
- Python for analysis
- Statistics
- Data visualization
- A/B testing
- Communicating insights to stakeholders

Nice to have
- Tableau
- dbt

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
